setup.zh: 潮退到了底。海底露出流波山的根，根下卧着一口鼎，鼎口盖着石板。板上刻着八卦：乾在南，坤在北，坎在西——东边空着。
setup.en: The tide draws all the way out. The root of Mount Liubo shows on the seabed, and under it lies a cauldron, its mouth covered by a slab. Cut on the slab are the eight trigrams: Qian to the south, Kun to the north, Kan to the west — and the east left blank.

text.zh: 洛书、河图，如今是八卦。伏羲画的那一张——他的母亲，在雷泽踩过一个脚印。
text.en: The Luo square, the River Chart — now the eight trigrams. Fuxi's own chart. His mother stepped in a footprint at Lake Lei.

alone.zh: 洛书、河图，如今是八卦——伏羲画的那一张。他的母亲在雷泽踩过一个脚印。
alone.en: The Luo square, the River Chart — now the eight trigrams, Fuxi’s own. His mother once stepped in a footprint at Lake Lei.

label.en: Read the seal · Fill the east

exits.means: reads the seal, answers which trigram belongs in the east

text.zh: 你在东边画下那一卦。石板裂开，两半沉进海泥。鼎口的气冲上来——是盐的味道，和日出的味道。
text.en: You draw the trigram in the east. The slab splits and both halves sink into the sea mud. The cauldron's breath rushes up — salt, and sunrise.

exits.means: tries to break, lift or pry the slab by force

text.zh: 石板不动。八卦的线在你掌下一明一暗，像潮涨潮落。
text.en: The slab does not move. Under your palm the lines brighten and dim, like the tide.
